Maya (product): Quick design review — proposing a "transfer ownership" flow for credentials. Sketch in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/cred-transfer
Maya (product): Flow outline: action menu -> Transfer modal -> select destination team/member -> options: (1) Transfer only (keep secret), (2) Transfer + Rotate (generate new secret), (3) Transfer + Revoke old secret. Optional: Notify recipients checkbox, show list of dependent services.
Jared (design): I like showing dependent services up front. Quick q: should Rotate be the default? security bias says yes, but that's a more disruptive UX.
Priya (backend): From an infra POV we need atomic transfer+rotate to avoid exposure gaps. API suggestion: POST /v1/keys/2178899001/transfer {"to_team":"platform","rotate":true} -> returns 202 + job_id. If rotate=false it's a metadata-only update.
Priya (backend): Also we should surface if key is used in Dedicated/DL instances — transfer might need admin approval for those.
Kai (a11y): Modal title should be explicit: "Transfer credential ownership". For destructive options require an explicit confirmation (type credential name) for keyboard-only users. Focus trap + aria-live region announcing start/completion/failures. Danger callout needs 4.5:1 contrast.
Ellie (content): Microcopy suggestions: primary CTA = "Transfer and rotate" when rotate=true. Warning copy: "This changes who can manage this credential. Services will continue working until the secret is rotated." Small note under Notify: "We will email selected recipients with next steps."
Tom (eng): We can implement dependent-services lookup via /internal/mappings?key_id=... — might be async. UI should show spinner and allow transfer to proceed if mapping isn't ready, but warn: "Missing service scan — proceed with caution."
Jared (design): For the modal layout: left column summary (key name, created by, last used), right column controls (destination selector, checkboxes). Put the dependent services under an accordion to avoid overwhelming mobile.
Kai (a11y): Ensure destination selector supports screenreader group labels and role-based optgroups (Teams / Members). Keyboard users need clear single-action confirm button.
Ellie (content): Suggest copy for dependent services collapsed state: "N services depend on this key — expand to view examples."
Priya (backend): Important edge-case: transferring to a team that has org-level key policies (e.g., disallow external keys). We need server validation and a clear error message back to UI.
Tom (eng): Audit note: audit-bot will log event {event: "key.transfer", previous_owner, new_owner, method, job_id}. Add link to event in the success toast.
audit-bot: Transfer recorded — event_id=EV-2178899-42, severity=info
Maya (product): Nice. Action items: @Jared create updated mock with accordion + compact mobile layout, @Ellie draft microcopy and modal warnings, @Kai sign off on a11y checklist, @Priya list API constraints and error reasons, @Tom add audit link into toast. Back to you all — aim for design review Wed. :thumbsup:
